snapshot.policy: One coherent immutable UI/native/layout capture, then workspace/checkpoint provenance; request slot retained until next explicit request, terminal/review cannot overwrite it. No baseline. No per-paint/per-RX disk publication.
snapshot.writer: single bounded lane; four mandatory tasks plus at most one coalescible healthy presentation; never carries raw/input/lease work
snapshot.pendingFailure: preserve uncertain .pending and fail closed; no cleanup/retry masking; lock prevents concurrent writers

sealProof: Native closed; journal closed/notfailed/commitAnchor; resourcesClosedNs; consentfalse/leaseIdnull/no localRC. Independent from later Checkpoint14/review; mandatory fresh live STATUS snapshot required by Supervisor. Failed raw history cannot qualify nominal flow.
completionProof: TERMINAL_DURABLE and then REVIEW_READY require original Checkpoint14 COMMITTED live source-bound postbarrier ACK and strict raw/source/context/archive/review proof, not just lifecycle strings.
recovery: NO_SESSION, no owner/lease restoration; valid old terminal/reviews retained; Checkpoint RECOVERED_NOT_LIVE_ACK never reused as a live ACK. New generation only explicit product bootstrap then visible CONNECT/consent.
